# Sakshi Yadav & Co.

> Sakshi Yadav & Co. is a Chartered Accountancy firm in Sector 18, Noida, led by CA Sakshi Yadav (ICAI member). The firm advises individuals, startups and growing businesses on income tax, GST, TDS, audit and assurance, company incorporation, ROC compliance and financial reporting — in person in Noida and online across India.

## Key facts
- Firm: Sakshi Yadav & Co., Chartered Accountants
- Founder & Principal: CA Sakshi Yadav — Chartered Accountant · Member, ICAI
- Office: SF-57, Ansal Fortune, Sector 18, Noida, Uttar Pradesh 201301, India
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 87962 15611
- Email: contact@sakshiyadavandco.in
- Hours: Mon – Sat, 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM
- Service area: Noida, Greater Noida, Ghaziabad, Delhi NCR in person; all of India online
- Website: https://sakshiyadavandco.in/
- Fees: quoted per assignment in writing (ICAI guidelines restrict advertising of fees)

## Services
- [Income Tax Return Filing & Tax Planning](https://sakshiyadavandco.in/services/income-tax): ITR filing for individuals, businesses & professionals with maximum tax savings.
- [GST Registration & GST Return Filing](https://sakshiyadavandco.in/services/gst-services): Complete GST compliance — registration to annual returns, notices & audit.
- [Tax Audit & Statutory Audit](https://sakshiyadavandco.in/services/tax-audit): Comprehensive Tax & Statutory Audit services for businesses and corporations.
- [TDS Return & Compliance](https://sakshiyadavandco.in/services/tds-compliance): Quarterly TDS/TCS return filing, deduction computation & Form 16 issuance.
- [Business Registration & Setup](https://sakshiyadavandco.in/services/business-registration): One-stop business setup — Proprietorship to Private Limited, FSSAI, IEC & NGO registrations.
- [ROC / Corporate Compliance](https://sakshiyadavandco.in/services/roc-compliance): Annual filings, board resolutions, minutes & all MCA/ROC compliance for companies.
- [Project Reports & CMA Data](https://sakshiyadavandco.in/services/project-reports): Bank loan project reports, CMA data & feasibility studies for all business types.
- [CA Certificates & Attestations](https://sakshiyadavandco.in/services/ca-certificates): Turnover, net worth, export and other certificates issued and signed by a practising Chartered Accountant.
- [Loan Documentation & Bank Liaison](https://sakshiyadavandco.in/services/loan-documentation): Complete loan file preparation — home, business, MSME & personal loan documentation.
- [F&O / Capital Gain Tax](https://sakshiyadavandco.in/services/fno-capital-gain): Specialised ITR filing for F&O traders, equity investors & capital gain computation.
